title: Admin Data Record Restore Request
description: Previews (dry_run) or performs the restore of an earlier version of a data-browser record. A restore is a new revision. Without dry_run, expected_version is required. Access: admin.data.read + table UPDATE.

expected_version.description: The current version the admin saw. A restore based on an older version is refused with 409.

field_keys.description: Restore only these fields. Omit to restore every field that differs.

dry_run.description: Only report what the restore would change and what blocks it; write nothing.
